findings.finding: Absci has an open at-the-market sales agreement with TD Securities for up to $100m, signed August 2025. It sold 3,662,246 shares for $12.5m net in H1 2026, leaving roughly $87.5m (my arithmetic, not a disclosed figure), so the program can sell into the 2026-10-08 session with no prior notice.
findings.mechanism_in_window: An ATM draw needs no new filing or pricing event; the agreement and effective shelf are already in place (10-Q, 2026-08-11), so supply can hit the tape on 2026-10-08 itself. Sales are disclosed only in the next 10-Q, so they are invisible inside the window.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No observed ATM-day reaction is available. In H1 2026 the company used the ATM at about $3.4/share average, then raised $100m underwritten at $7.41 on 2026-06-24, and the stock rose after that raise (next-close +35.96% after the 2026-06-23 drop in the baseline's own history). It has $201.1m of cash and marketable securities at 2026-06-30, so it has no forced need to sell.
findings.why_not_priced: The fall is at ordinary volume and no new supply event is known, so the price holds no specific draw. The ATM is a standing, discretionary seller that caps any bounce rather than a dated shoe. If the market expected a draw, the second leg would have come on heavy volume. Instead it came on 1.09x.
